methodology.order: Rotate all three modes each repetition
methodology.includes: SQL parsing, binding, access, row resolution, WHERE, downstream operators and result materialization
methodology.data: id=i+1, k=i%10, v=floor(i/10)%5; exact predecessor and current databases have identical rows and explicit indexes
caveats: Warmed shared-host Node measurements, not browser latency guarantees
Nine-sample nearest-rank p95 is the maximum
Unordered LIMIT/DISTINCT checks existing stable source order, not a general SQL ordering guarantee
matchedRowIds is total eager matches before, consumed validated matches after; sourceRows counts emitted frames in both
